title: The role of SPI1-TYROBP-FCER1G network in oncogenesis and prognosis of osteosarcoma, and its association with immune infiltration.
authors: Li, Jiahua; Shi, Hui; Yuan, Zhanyuan; Wu, Zhiheng; Li, Haohao; Liu, Yuelong; Lu, Ming; Lu, Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组和PPI网络分析骨肉瘤中SPI1-TYROBP-FCER1G网络与免疫浸润，仅用ChEA3预测转录因子SPI1，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Osteosarcoma is an aggressive malignant bone sarcoma worldwide. A causal gene network with specific functions underlying both the development and progression of OS was still unclear. Here we firstly identified the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between control and OS samples, and then defined the hub genes and top clusters in the protein-protein interaction (PPI) network of these DEGs. By focusing on the hub gene TYROBP in the top 1 cluster, a conserved TYROBP co-expression network was identified. Then the effect of the network on OS overall survival was analyzed. Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) were used to explore the functions of the network. XCell platform and ssGSEA algorithm were conducted to estimate the status of immune infiltration. ChEA3 platform, GSEA enrichment analysis, and Drug Pair Seeker (DPS) were used to predict the key transcription factor and its upstream signal. We identified the downregulated SPI1-TYROBP-FCER1G network in OS, which were significantly enriched in immune-related functions. We also defined a two-gene signature (SPI1/FCER1G) that can predict poorer OS overall survival and the attenuated immune infiltration when downregulated. The SPI1-TYROBP-FCER1G network were potentially initiated by transcription factor SPI1 and would lead to the upregulated CD86, MHC-II, CCL4/CXCL10/CX3CL1 and hence increased immune infiltrations. With this study, we could better explore the mechanism of OS oncogenesis and metastasis for developing new therapies.
abstract_zh: 骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）是一种全球范围内侵袭性恶性骨肉瘤。目前，在OS的发生和发展过程中，具有特定功能的因果基因网络仍不清楚。本研究首先鉴定了对照组与OS样本之间的差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs），随后在这些DEGs的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络中定义了核心基因（hub genes）和顶级聚类。通过聚焦于顶级聚类1中的核心基因TYROBP，我们识别出一个保守的TYROBP共表达网络。接着，分析了该网络对OS总生存期的影响。利用基因本体论（Gene Ontology, GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）富集分析以及基因集富集分析（Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, GSEA）来探索该网络的功能。采用XCell平台和ssGSEA算法评估免疫浸润状态。使用ChEA3平台、GSEA富集分析和药物配对搜索器（Drug Pair Seeker, DPS）预测关键转录因子及其上游信号。我们识别出在OS中下调的SPI1-TYROBP-FCER1G网络，该网络显著富集于免疫相关功能。我们还定义了一个双基因特征（SPI1/FCER1G），其下调可预测较差的OS总生存期和减弱的免疫浸润。SPI1-TYROBP-FCER1G网络可能由转录因子SPI1启动，并导致CD86、MHC-II、CCL4/CXCL10/CX3CL1的上调，从而增加免疫浸润。通过本研究，我们能够更深入地探索OS的肿瘤发生和转移机制，以开发新的治疗方法。
